title: Extend low degree coefficients
statement: Given natural numbers $n$ and $\ell$, extend a coefficient function on subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$ to all subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ by retaining the given coefficient on subsets of size at most $\ell$ and assigning $0$ to every larger subset.
